# FAERS raw data dictionary

*Generated by `scripts/profile_raw_data.py` from `data/raw/` (duckdb 1.5.6). Row-level profile covers **all 55 quarters (2012Q4..2026Q2)**. Meanings come from the FDA ASC_NTS documentation shipped in the quarter folders (2012Q4 .doc for the original fields, 2026Q2 PDF for fields added later); where the docs are silent the text says "unclear". All values were loaded as strings (latin-1, `$`-delimited, quoting disabled, bad lines skipped); empty fields count as missing.*

## Overview

- **Quarters on disk:** 2012Q4 to 2026Q2, 55 folders; missing quarters in that range: none. Quarters are already unzipped (no .zip files in data/raw/); folder-name case is inconsistent (e.g. `2019Q1` vs `2022q1`).
- **Profiled quarters:** 55 (2012Q4..2026Q2).
- **Total rows:** DEMO 20,536,224, DRUG 84,596,271, REAC 66,260,415, OUTC 15,178,513, RPSR 921,624, THER 29,344,670, INDI 55,831,410.
- **Key relationships (verified across the profiled quarters):**
  - `primaryid` = `caseid` || `caseversion` for 20,536,224 of 20,536,224 DEMO rows (0 mismatches). `i_f_code`='F' exactly when `caseversion` > 1: True.
  - DEMO has 20,536,224 rows = 20,535,517 distinct `primaryid` (707 `primaryid`s appear in more than one quarter) covering 17,683,864 distinct `caseid`. 2,102,832 cases have more than one version in the data (max 27 versions of one case, though `caseversion` values reach 256 - not every version is published). 2,102,831 cases have versions in more than one quarter.
  - DRUG, REAC, OUTC, RPSR, THER, INDI all carry `primaryid` + `caseid`; every child `primaryid` exists in DEMO (same quarter) and `caseid` always agrees with DEMO. THER and INDI link to DRUG via (`primaryid`, `drug_seq`) with `dsg_drug_seq` / `indi_drug_seq`; 1 THER and 0 INDI keys lack a matching DRUG row.
  - DEMO `primaryid`s with no row in the child table: DRUG 2 (0.0%), REAC 55 (0.0%), OUTC 8,729,008 (42.5%), RPSR 19,735,394 (96.1%), THER 9,119,396 (44.4%), INDI 1,758,330 (8.6%).

Documentation as shipped in the folders: every quarter had Readme/FAQs and an ASC_NTS (.doc/.pdf; `ASC_NT.pdf` in 2013Q1) plus per-table PDFs; 7 quarters used .doc files, the rest PDF only. Only the ASC_NTS files remain in `data/raw/` (the rest were deleted as unused). 30 quarters (2019Q1..2026Q2) also have a `deleted/` (or `Deleted/`) folder with deleted-case lists (2019Q1 has two files); these are not among the seven tables and are not profiled here.

## Schema changes across years

Header comparison covers all 55 quarters (first line of every table file, lower-cased and stripped).

| Table | First quarter with the change | Change | Evidence / docs |
|---|---|---|---|
| DEMO | 2014Q3 (vs 2012Q4) | added `auth_num`, `lit_ref`, `age_grp`, `sex`; dropped `gndr_cod` | ASC_NTS revision history (Apr 2015, QDE 2014Q3): 'Modified field header from GNDR_COD to SEX'; AUTH_NUM, LIT_REF, AGE_GRP added at the same time. |
| DRUG | 2013Q1 (vs 2012Q4) | added `lot_num`; dropped `lot_nbr` | Spelling variant of the same field (ASC_NTS always calls it LOT_NUM); treated as a rename lot_nbr -> lot_num. |
| DRUG | 2014Q3 (vs 2013Q1) | added `prod_ai` | ASC_NTS: new field in 2014Q3 extract. |
| REAC | 2014Q3 (vs 2012Q4) | added `drug_rec_act` | ASC_NTS: new field in 2014Q3 extract. |
| OUTC | 2013Q1 (vs 2012Q4) | added `outc_cod`; dropped `outc_code` | Spelling variant of the same field (ASC_NTS calls it OUTC_COD); treated as a rename outc_code -> outc_cod. |

Tables with no header change in any quarter: RPSR, THER, INDI. No column changed position after these changes: the header was identical in every quarter from 2014Q3 to 2026Q2 for all seven tables.

**Other schema / documentation observations**

- Header anomalies: ` rept_dt` has a leading space in `demo12q4.txt` and `drug12q4.txt` starts with a UTF-8 BOM (a naive reader sees `\ufeffprimaryid`). No other header anomalies in any of the 385 files. The script strips and lower-cases all header names.
- Field names in the files differ from the ASC_NTS field list in places: file `i_f_code` vs doc `I_F_COD`; file `init_fda_dt` vs 2012Q4 doc `INIT_FDA_DATE`; file `caseid` vs doc tag `CASE_ID` in the LAERS-vs-FAERS comparison table; file `cum_dose_unit` vs doc `CUM_DOS_UNIT`.
- Value-set changes announced in the 2026Q2 ASC_NTS revision history, checked against the data: `rept_cod` `5DAY`/`30DAY` (doc: added QDE 2022Q3) first appear in **2020** in the data; `role_cod` `DN` (doc: added QDE 2024Q4) first appears in 2024; country codes switch to GENC from QDE 2021Q4 (not verifiable from values alone; `reporter_country` has 256 distinct values incl. non-country entries such as `EU` and `COUNTRY NOT SPECIFIED`). The cumulative-dose-unit list was corrected in QDE 2014Q1 (doc).
- Cross-year consequences when stacking quarters: sex is `gndr_cod` through 2014Q2 and `sex` from 2014Q3 (coalesce them); `lot_nbr`/`lot_num` and `outc_code`/`outc_cod` need harmonising; `auth_num`, `lit_ref`, `age_grp`, `prod_ai`, `drug_rec_act` do not exist before 2014Q3.
- Inferred casts are in the column tables above; none of the numeric-looking columns is perfectly clean (`age`, `wt`, `cum_dose_chr`, `dose_amt`, `dur` contain some non-numeric text), so casts should use coercion with the failures kept for review. Date columns hold partial dates (YYYY / YYYYMM / YYYYMMDD) and cannot be cast to a plain date type without a rule for partial dates.

## Data quality issues

All counts are over the 55 profiled quarters (2012Q4..2026Q2) unless stated.

**Malformed rows / file format**

- 385 table files loaded; **0 lines skipped**, 0 short lines, 0 blank lines; no line anywhere has a field count different from its file's header.
- Line endings are not uniform: 145 files (in 22 quarters, 2017Q4, 2018Q1, 2020Q1, 2020Q2, ... 2026Q2) use LF only instead of CRLF; no file mixes the two. Matters if a reader keeps a trailing `\r` on the last column.
- A last-line terminator is present in every file; row counts loaded equal the data-line counts in every file.

**Encoding**

- Non-ASCII bytes occur in few lines: DRUG 11,766, DEMO 8, none in the other tables. **11,769 of 11,774 non-ASCII lines are valid UTF-8** - i.e. the files are UTF-8, not latin-1 - and 5 are not (DRUG 2019Q3: 5 lines). Reading as latin-1 (as instructed) therefore turns multibyte characters into mojibake, e.g. `Botox®` becomes `BotoxÂ®`.
- 3,300 U+FFFD replacement characters (`\xef\xbf\xbd`) already exist in the source (all in `drug12q4.txt`, e.g. `0.2\ufffd0.4 MG/KG/MIN`): information lost upstream, not recoverable by choosing a different decoding.

**Duplicates**

- DEMO: 20,536,224 rows vs 20,535,517 distinct `primaryid`; 707 `primaryid`s occur in more than one quarter (41 different quarter combinations), 423 identical in every column and 284 differing in at least one. 401 of them involve **2020Q3**, which re-publishes cases first seen in 2012-2018 (largest groups: 2025Q1|2025Q2 x131, 2015Q2|2015Q3 x93, 2012Q4|2013Q1 x50, 2018Q2|2020Q3 x46).
- Exact duplicate rows (all columns identical, counted via a 64-bit hash, includes repeats across quarters): DRUG 8,477, REAC 377,308, OUTC 716, RPSR 261, THER 104,528, INDI 26,427.
- DRUG: 427,542 (`primaryid`, `drug_seq`) keys occur more than once (1,316,102 rows), although ASC_NTS describes `drug_seq` as the order within a case. Only 5,681 of those keys have identical rows; 8,344 span more than one quarter. (`primaryid`, `drug_seq`) is therefore not a unique key.
- REAC: 378,470 repeated (`primaryid`, `pt`) pairs; OUTC: 716 repeated (`primaryid`, `outc_cod`) pairs.
- Primary-suspect coverage in DRUG: of 20,535,515 `primaryid`s, 20,342,655 have exactly one `PS` row, **190,438 have more than one**, **2,422 have none**.

**Weird / implausible values**

- Dates: `event_dt` raw range 00010101..50230906 (8-digit); 63 8-digit values before year 1900, 37 after 20260630, 0 not valid calendar dates; `mfr_dt` raw range 00040603..52020419 (8-digit); 9 8-digit values before year 1900, 7 after 20260630, 0 not valid calendar dates; `rept_dt` raw range 01121119..91120102 (8-digit); 44 8-digit values before year 1900, 16 after 20260630, 0 not valid calendar dates; `start_dt` raw range 00100625..90140211 (8-digit); 188 8-digit values before year 1900, 189 after 20260630, 0 not valid calendar dates; `end_dt` raw range 00011204..30150330 (8-digit); 30 8-digit values before year 1900, 77 after 20260630, 0 not valid calendar dates. `init_fda_dt` and `fda_dt` are always clean 8-digit dates within the quarter range.
- Date order: `event_dt` is later than `fda_dt` in 346 of 7,596,090 8-digit cases; `rept_dt` is later than `fda_dt` in 617,324 of 20,524,636; `init_fda_dt` > `fda_dt` in 221.
- Quarter files are not date-pure: e.g. 2012Q4 holds `fda_dt` 20120424..20121231; 2013Q1 holds `fda_dt` 20120106..20130331; 2013Q2 holds `fda_dt` 20120406..20130630 (full ranges in the profile JSON). No `fda_dt` is later than its file's quarter end.
- `age`: 13,934 rows have an age but no `age_cod`, 680 have a unit but no age; non-numeric ages {'U': 11, 'FEW': 2}; ages in years range -6179 to 2020 (56 negative, 64 above 120).
- `wt`: numeric values range 0 to 94380; free text sits in the numeric field, e.g. `UNK`, `U`, `N/A`, ```, `F`, `86.2KG`, `YR`, `65-70`. `wt_cod` has values outside the documented KG/LBS/GMS: `YEARS` 7, `YR` 5, `KGS` 4, `L` 3, `Y` 3, `LG` 2, `IB` 1, `L;` 1, `M` 1, `MG` 1, `UNK` 1, `YEAR` 1.
- `occp_cod` has values not in the 2012Q4 docs (MD, PH, OT, LW, CN): `HP` 2,228,480, `RN` 8,653, `SALES` 10; it is 1.2% (2017Q4) to 72.1% (2026Q2) missing by quarter.
- `reporter_country` mixes 2-letter codes with the literal `COUNTRY NOT SPECIFIED` (806,702 rows) and `EU` (173,560); `occr_country` is 2-letter only and 0.0% (2019Q4) to 17.9% (2013Q1) missing by quarter.
- Sex: `gndr_cod` (2012Q4-2014Q2) has `F`, `M`, `NS` (107,200), `UNK`; `sex` (2014Q3+) has `F`, `M`, `UNK` and undocumented `P` 158, `I` 109, `T` 73 (no `NS`), and is blank in 14.1% of rows (8.0% (2015Q3) to 21.7% (2020Q3) by quarter) versus 1.3% for `gndr_cod`. `gndr_cod` was blank in 8.469% of 2012Q4 rows but 0% in the next six quarters.
- `dechal` / `rechal` fill rate flips over time (mean of quarterly % filled): 2012: dechal 3% / rechal 94%; 2013: dechal 3% / rechal 91%; 2014: dechal 3% / rechal 93%; 2015: dechal 1% / rechal 77%; 2016: dechal 20% / rechal 22%; 2017: dechal 48% / rechal 20%; 2018: dechal 54% / rechal 16%; 2019: dechal 50% / rechal 15%; 2020: dechal 51% / rechal 14%; 2021: dechal 61% / rechal 13%; 2022: dechal 57% / rechal 11%; 2023: dechal 55% / rechal 8%; 2024: dechal 59% / rechal 8%; 2025: dechal 60% / rechal 11%; 2026: dechal 57% / rechal 22%. Through 2015Q3 `dechal` is almost empty and `rechal` almost full (dominated by `D`); from 2015Q4 `rechal` drops sharply and `dechal` fills. The docs do not explain this - **unclear** whether the two columns were misaligned in the older extracts. `dechal` has one stray `` ` `` value and `rechal` one `' N'`.
- DRUG text fields: 8,488,844 of 16,992,912 non-blank `lot_num` values start with a space; 44,487 `drugname` values have leading/trailing whitespace; 4 rows have a blank `drugname`; case is mixed within the same value (`TABLET`/`Tablet` in `dose_form`, `ORAL`/`Oral` and `UNKNOWN`/`Unknown` in `route`); `exp_dt` holds 1,096 comma-separated multi-value strings (e.g. `20140831,20131230`).
- `route` is 32.6% blank and also contains explicit `Unknown`/`UNKNOWN` (22,930,465 rows): two encodings of 'unknown'; 435 distinct values because of case/wording variants.
- `cum_dose_unit` values in the files are text codes (`MG`, `UG/KG`, ...) whereas the 2012Q4 ASC_NTS lists numeric codes 001-004 (the 2013Q2 doc lists the text codes); 43 distinct values observed, including both `MG/M**2` and `MG/M2`.
- `rpsr_cod` has a trailing-space variant `HP ` (8,797 rows) next to `HP`; `dur_cod` has 31 values vs 7 documented (`DAYS`, `YEARS`, `MO`, stray `2`, `MG`, ...).
- `role_cod` is blank in 6 DRUG rows; `rept_cod` has `5DAY`/`30DAY` (6,877/140,469) not in the 2012Q4 docs.
- Orphans: 0 child rows without a DEMO parent in the same quarter; 2 DEMO `primaryid`s have no DRUG rows and 55 have no REAC rows.

## Decisions

The choices made after reviewing this profile (drug role, case version, time axis, encoding, duplicates, drug identity, event term, outcomes, demographics, reporter group, `dechal`/`rechal`) are recorded in [`DECISIONS.md`](../DECISIONS.md), together with their evidence and limitations. Column definitions for the processed tables are in `case_tables_data_dictionary.md`.

Caveats about this document: it was generated with the original latin-1 loading rule, so non-ASCII drug names in value counts show as mojibake (the loader now uses UTF-8 with a latin-1 fallback); the RPSR, THER and INDI tables were profiled but their raw files have since been deleted from `data/raw/` (the build does not use them), so a rebuild would not include them.
